verdict.rationale: Windmill supports self-hosting a dev instance via Docker Compose (windmill-docs-10) and provides a CLI (`wmill`) for interacting with instances and deploying from Git repos (windmill-docs-9, windmill-docs-4, windmill-docs-11), which could support CI workflows against a dev instance. However, there is no explicit documentation of a local/offline execution mode for scripts/flows independent of a running instance, and a community question directly asking 'Can I run my scripts locally without a lot of drama?' (windmill-comm-5) goes unanswered in the evidence, suggesting friction. Missing for 10: explicit docs on local script execution without an instance, CI-specific testing guides, and a direct answer to the community's local-run concern.
